title: DecisionSnapshot
description: Immutable, frozen record of every input that produced a decision. Replay re-evaluates against this row only — no live sources are consulted. delegation_ancestry is captured here at evaluation time so that replays reproduce the same authority lineage without re-querying live delegation state.

evaluation_id.description: v1 back-compat alias; same row, distinct identity column. New writers populate both.

delegation_id.description: The delegation record that authorized this evaluation, if the request was made by a delegated actor. Captured at evaluation time.

oneOf.description: Ordered delegation hops from originating principal to the actor, frozen at evaluation time. Covered by the audit-chain hash (chain entry hashes this snapshot). Index 0 is the top-level grant.
